en.title: One thing at a time

Stop in a clear place to write.
Put the phone away; look around.

en.title: Turn the claim into checkable questions
en.subtitle: An editorial guide • not findings about this case
items: What were the criteria, bids and reasons for the award?
Who ultimately controls or benefits from the winning company?
What was paid, what was delivered, and who verified it?
en.caption: These questions connect the decision, the people and the public result. They draw on general FATF and UN procurement principles; they do not establish misconduct.
en.alt: Three questions for scrutinising a public contract: selection criteria, ultimate company control and verified delivery.
en.foot: Document guide • no guilt or loss calculation

sq.title: Kthejeni pretendimin në pyetje konkrete
sq.subtitle: Udhëzues editorial • jo përfundime për këtë rast
items: Cilat ishin kriteret, ofertat dhe arsyet e shpalljes së fituesit?
Kush e kontrollon ose përfiton në fund nga kompania fituese?
Çfarë u pagua, çfarë u realizua dhe kush e verifikoi?
sq.caption: Këto pyetje lidhin vendimin, njerëzit dhe rezultatin publik. Mbështeten në parime të përgjithshme të FATF-së dhe OKB-së; nuk vërtetojnë shkelje.
sq.alt: Tri pyetje për një kontratë publike: kriteret e përzgjedhjes, kontrolli real i kompanisë dhe realizimi i verifikuar.

en.title: What did you notice on the way?

What made this part worth keeping?
en.caption: Editorial prompts inspired by the clip and Berkeley’s savoring-walk practice; no happiness score is implied.
en.alt: Three prompts invite you to see a detail, attend to the moment and name what made it worth keeping.
